dct_description_sm: Data on boreal mammal communities from Alberta, Canada, conducted for the joint Federal-Provincial Oil Sands Monitoring program (Terrestrial Biological Monitoring group) from 2021–2022. These data are from two different Landscape Units (LU3 and LU2). The data describes the sampling locations of remote infrared camera arrays, the locations of those arrays, the mammal data collected from the cameras, and the landscapes surrounding those arrays.
dct_title_s: Data for Oil Sands Monitoring - Terrestrial Mammals - 2021–2022
